set.body:
Objective

Represent direction structurally through ordered left and right relation families rather than a directed boolean.

Primary ownership

R/relation.R, R/pairing.R, compiler preflight and plan hashing, associated tests.

Deliverables

- Keep each effect_relation homogeneous; compile a left relation and optional right relation into one task.
- Require uniform experimental and neural space within each selected side, not across both sides.
- Replace new internal directed-pairing use with ordered partition edges and an explicit reducer.
- Expand ordinary unordered cross-partition pairs into both ordered orientations with half weight, permitting later compiler fusion.
- Add an internal same-neural-domain/shared-feature bridge.
- Reject distinct neural spaces without an explicit compatible bridge before source admission.
- Include axes, ordered edges, reducer, and bridge in scientific-plan identity.

Acceptance

Left/right reversal changes task identity and implies a transpose; invalid axes, partitions, domains, or bridges fail before reads; same-relation source handles remain deduplicated; existing cross_partitions() numerical semantics are preserved.

Non-goals

No general cross-space bridge or edge normalization yet.
set.title: Compile ordered two-sided relation tasks and bridge preflight
